raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Motivation The DSV4 draft-extend CUDA graph prologue translated full KV-cache locations into SWA locations with two GPU launches on every replay: an int64 mapping gather followed by an int32 cast. This is a latency-sensitive captured path, so the two operations can be expressed more directly as one kernel. ## Modifications - Compiled the index select + int32 casting with torch compile during capturing ## Speed Tests and Profiling main: PR: ## Checklist - [x] Format the changed code with Black and isort. - [x] Add unit tests for the fused kernel and backend routing. - [x] No documentation update is required for this internal kernel optimization. - [ ] Add speed benchmark and profiling results. - [x] Follow the SGLang code style guidance. --- ### CI States Latest PR Test (Base): :x: [Run #30799229529](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/30799229529) Latest PR Test (Extra): :x: [Run #30799229319](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/30799229319)
